Market today: Mixed signals. Stronger-than-expected GDP is a positive, but accelerating inflation (Fed's preferred gauge) suggests rates might stay high, which is tough for growth and tech names. The chip sector has some positive leadership news from Nvidia.

Your holdings: SOXL (-87.76%), MUU (-76.69%), and SPAL (-62.15%) are deeply underwater leveraged positions, amplifying losses. METU (-29.13%) is flagged for TRIM and is very close to its stop. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on inflation data and any Fed commentary, as this will dictate the interest rate environment. Also, monitor how key tech names react to mixed economic news.

Bottom line: With high concentration and margin, aggressive risk management on your leveraged and deeply red positions is paramount.
plays: METU is flagged for TRIM and is near its stop at 18.3. Consider reducing exposure to this leveraged position to manage risk.
SPY is also flagged for SELL and is very close to its stop at 705. Be ready to exit if it breaks this level.
Review stops on all your deeply underwater leveraged ETFs like SOXL, MUU, and PLTU. Their default stops are far off, indicating they need adjustment.
